caption: The drawing depicts a circular wooden frame with a light brown and dark brown marbled appearance, set against a plain beige background. Inside the frame, there is an arrangement of various flowers in the form of a partial wreath or crescent, starting from the lower left and arching up to the upper right. The floral composition includes a large pink rose, a large white and purple blossom, smaller blue flowers, yellow bell-shaped flowers, and red buds, all with accompanying green leaves and stems. The flowers are detailed and colored naturally, with distinctive blue, yellow, red, pink, and green shades. The central background within the circular frame is a light cream or beige color, matching the larger outer background. There is a small handwritten inscription just below the lower right side of the frame, which appears to read “Clarence Deon '37.”
title: Framed Flower Painting
